messages:
maya: FYI deploying keystone service v1.10.0 to canary at 02:00 UTC. Feature flag 'keystone_split' will be ramped 0 -> 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over ~90m. Please ACK if you have any holdpoints.

deploybot: Scheduled deploy created: id=deploy-6999999999-keystone. Will perform FF shifts at +10m/+30m/+60m/+90m. Rollback hooks enabled. See: https://deploys.redwood/deploy-6999999999 :robot_face:

rob: Quick Q — do we need to pin any downstream services to v1.9.2 for the first 30m? last time a mismatch caused auth token handling diffs.

sangeeta: Heads up — EU change window runs until 02:30 UTC. Either delay EU traffic or start EU at 0% and keep pinned until 03:00. Prefer avoid full ramp for EU during window.

alex: Rollback / abort criteria proposal:
- 5xx rate > 0.4% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency +100ms vs baseline for 5m
- keystone-internal error spike (auth failures) > 0.2%
If any trigger, auto-drop FF to 0% and pin traffic to previous version, then pager if not resolved in 10m.

katie: I'll add these rollback criteria to release notes and the release checklist. Also add the FF change steps and contact list.

ben: Ops note — if we jump to 60% quickly we might churn sticky sessions. Can we enable transient sticky-slice for the 30->60 step, or do a soft-drain?

nina: ACK, watching dashboards. I'll perform the toggles and post telemetry after each step.

deploybot: Action: toggled feature keystone_split=10% at 02:10 UTC (actor=nina). Link: https://flags.redwood/keystone_split/changes/6999999999 :rocket:

maya: nina — I see a small auth error blip on the dashboard immediately after 10% (0.12% -> 0.45%). Can you hold and revert if it doesn't settle in 2m?

nina: Reverting to 0% now, running quick diag.

deploybot: Action: toggled feature keystone_split=0% at 02:12 UTC (actor=nina). Rollback: pinned routing to v1.9.2 for keystone. Deploy status: partial rollback executed.

alex: Good call. Opening rollback runbook and starting an RCA thread. If we can't stabilize by 02:30 UTC, escalate to oncall SRE.

katie: Release notes draft updated: "Canary ramp halted due to auth error spike; feature flag reverted; investigating."

ben: Filing a quick follow-up task to add per-region slowstarts to the FF choreography so EU has its own ramp.

rob: Thanks all. Once we confirm no residual issues, can we re-run the staged ramp with EU pinned to 0% until 03:00? Also suggest increment steps 5%->15%->35%->60% to be gentler.

maya: Agreed. Re-schedule attempt for 03:15 UTC, EU pinned at 0% initially. Nina, poke when you're ready and we'll go stepwise. :thumbsup:

nina: Will run a dry-run on staging now and report back in ~20m.

deploybot: Note: deploy-6999999999 marked as rollback-complete. All automated rollback hooks executed. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/deploy-6999999999/logs

maya: Closing this thread for now — follow-up scheduled in release calendar and ops checklist updated. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
